reportTime.description: Time at which this report was generated. If omitted, the server sets it to the time the request was received.

percentCompletion.description: Current progress expressed as a percentage of total task execution

executionTime.description: Time period during which the command was executed or is scheduled to be executed, depending on the status code

message.description: Human readable message providing details of the current status

results.description: New result(s) of the command available at the time of the progress report
